desc: The Bulldog Trio Vault line gives quick, secure access to handguns with three ways to open: an emergency key, a 4-8 digit LED keypad and a self-learning biometric fingerprint reader that stores up to 20 prints. Each vault is built from 16-gauge steel with a soft egg-crate foam interior, an interior LED light, audible or silent mode, a low battery indicator and a tamper/vibration alarm. The line includes the single front-opening quick vault (11"x8"x5"), the double quick vault with shelf (11"x10"x8") and the single top-load quick vault (13"x8.25"x2.75") that includes a security cable. All models are finished in black and run on 4 AA batteries (not included).
